title: add-jsonschema-response-format-and-strict-validation
author: Ava Chen
description: Add first-class JSON Schema response_format with optional strict validation mode. Motivation: customers increasingly rely on structured outputs (tool/function calling, downstream parsers) and need both a developer-friendly API and deterministic validation errors. This PR implements a new response_format value 'json_schema' and a strict variant 'json_schema_strict' that enforces schema compliance prior to returning a successful response. Key details: - New API parameter: response_format={json_schema|json_schema_strict}. When provided, the SDK/server performs incremental validation of streaming output against the provided JSON Schema and emits structured validation errors. - Streaming stability: implemented an incremental JSON parser/validator so we can surface partial validation issues during streaming without waiting for finalization. Streaming still yields tokens as before; when the final object fails validation, we append a structured error envelope and return non-200 semantics for strict mode. For non-strict mode we include a validation_warnings array in the response metadata. - Function/tool calling integration: when response_format is json_schema and the call is a function/tool invocation, the runtime prefers returning the parsed JSON object directly to the caller and validates against the function schema as well. This makes tool invocation deterministic when combined with strict mode. - OpenAI compatibility layer: mapped the new response_format to the compatibility endpoint so existing OpenAI-based clients can opt into schema mode using the same parameter name. The compatibility adapter translates between Redwood enums and the OpenAI surface and preserves function_call behaviors. - Validation implementation: introduced pkg/validation/jsonschema_validator.go and vendor dependency on github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema for performance and streaming validation. Validation errors are standardized into a compact error type with fields: path, keyword, message, value_preview. - Error semantics: strict mode returns an HTTP 422 with a machine-readable error payload when final output fails schema, and streams a partial validation error envelope if the issue is detectable before completion. Non-strict mode returns 200 with validation_warnings in metadata and a best-effort corrected_output field if we can safely coerce. - Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged when response_format is omitted. Added opt-in flags for Dedicated/Private deployments to enable stricter logging of validation failures. - Docs and SDK updates: updated TS/Python SDK request helpers and the API reference examples. Added end-to-end tests for streaming+schema validation and new unit tests for validator edge cases. Checklist: - [x] API surface + server plumbing - [x] Streaming parser + incremental validation - [x] Function/tool calling integration - [x] OpenAI compatibility adapter update - [x] Unit + e2e tests - [x] Docs and examples - [x] Changelog/release notes
commits_summary: feat(schema): add jsonschema response_format and strict mode | fix(streaming): incremental parser to support validation during stream | feat(compat): map response_format in openai adapter | test: add e2e tests for streaming schema validation | docs: examples and API reference updates

Ava Chen (2026-02-12): Responded: added a benchmark harness under e2e/benchmarks/streaming_schema and a config toggle 'validation_mode' (off/soft/strict) that can be tuned per-route. Updated docs with the error envelope shape and examples.
Carlos Ortega (2026-02-14): Request changes: move the jsonschema vendor to internal/vendored and add stricter timeout for validator on large payloads to avoid head-of-line blocking.
Ava Chen (2026-02-15): Addressed: moved dependency and added context-based timeout with default 250ms for incremental validation slices; added metrics for validation duration.
Maya Singh (2026-02-16): Approved after verifying CI and e2e coverage. Notes: please follow up with a post-merge task to add telemetry dashboards for validation failures (ENG-4952).
release_notes: Added response_format=json_schema and json_schema_strict. Streaming incremental validation and structured validation error payloads. OpenAI compatibility adapter updated to support schema mode. SDKs and docs updated. Opt-in strict behavior for Dedicated/Private deployments.
